drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A dusty, sampled acoustic piano plays a repetitive four-bar loop featuring jazz-influenced seventh chords with a slight vinyl crackle effect. The drum kit consists of a muffled, low-passed kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a slight swing. A sub-bass follows the root notes of the piano progression. A subtle, high-pitched sine wave synth melody enters periodically with long portamento glides. 88 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of C minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, sampled acoustic piano loop]

[Main Section]
[muffled kick drum enters, dry snare on beats 2 and 4]
[sub-bass follows piano root notes]

[Bridge]
[high-pitched sine synth with portamento melody]
[drums continue with slight swing]

bass.tags: Dark Ambient, Industrial. A low-frequency analog synthesizer drone oscillates with a slow, rhythmic pulse. Metallic, resonant percussion hits occur at irregular intervals with long reverb tails. A high-pitched, dissonant sine wave whistle enters intermittently. Distorted white noise textures swell and fade. 60 BPM. Key of C minor.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]

[distorted white noise swells]

[Section B]
[high-pitched dissonant sine wave whistle]
[sub-bass frequency modulation]
